$comment: First-load JS per route, gzipped, in kilobytes. Checked by scripts/check-bundle-budget.ts.
Seeded from a real build with ~3% headroom: tight enough that a stray import fails,
loose enough that a dependency patch does not. Raise a number only with a reason.
/dashboard 209 -> 215: the image field became an editable combobox on Radix Popover.
Replacing the preset chips was expected to pay for it and did not — ThemeToggle imports
ToggleGroup from radix-ui directly, so that dependency stays in the graph on every route
however many components stop using the wrapper. Popover is therefore purely additive
(~1.5 kB; its popper, portal, presence and dismissable-layer are already in via Select),
alongside the combobox's own keyboard and ARIA state machine and the project watcher.
Measured at 209.1 kB, set at actual + ~3% as above.
/_not-found 146 -> 167: the top bar moved into the root layout, so the landing page,
the dashboard, its loading state, its error boundary and the 404 stop each declaring
their own — which is what left the login page with a floating theme toggle and the 404
with no chrome, no <main> and no width at all. ThemeToggle is a client component, so
every route now carries Radix ToggleGroup and the shared Slot core (~20 kB gzip) that
only / and /dashboard used to. Measured 161.8 kB, up from 142.1. Deliberate: a 404
that cannot say which app it belongs to was the thing being fixed. /dashboard fell
209.1 -> 207.5 in the same change, because its header skeleton is now dead code.
/ 166 -> 171: restoring the headroom this number was supposed to have. It had been
seeded at 166.0 against a budget of 166 — flush, not 3% under — so the landing page
failed the gate on a change that did not touch it. The container list gained a filter
bar and paging; the landing page's own first-load moved 166.0 -> 166.2, entirely from
the shared layout graph re-splitting (12.9 + 3.6 kB became 9.0 + 7.7 kB), and its
route chunk is byte-identical. Set at actual + ~3% as the rule above intends.
/dashboard absorbed the feature itself at 211.7 -> 214.7, inside its existing budget:
the status chips reuse ToggleGroup, already in the graph via ThemeToggle, and the
origin checkboxes are native inputs rather than Radix Checkbox.
/dashboard 215 -> 222: the accessibility and shared-refresh work. Measured 215.0,
which is 0.0 kB over the previous number — the budget had been seeded flush against
214.7 rather than with the ~3% this file's own rule asks for, so it was one rounding
step from failing on a change that did not touch the route. Three additions account
for it: use-throttled-refresh, which container-row now calls instead of useRouter
directly; the ui/page column primitive, reached from the layout's header and footer;
and the skip link. All three are small — the whole delta is 0.3 kB — and the page
shell replaces seven hand-written className blobs, so the source is smaller than
before. Re-seeded at actual + ~3% as the rule above intends, rather than at actual.
/_not-found 167 -> 171: same measurement, 165.8 against 161.8 previously. The 404
renders the root layout, so it pays for the same shared graph the dashboard does —
the page primitive and the skip link — plus the layout re-splitting its chunks. It
was already the route with the least of its own code and the most inherited, which
is why a change to shared chrome shows up here most clearly.
